publication.title: Demonstration of Faceted Search on Scholarly Knowledge Graphs

adjudication.basis: Dynamic facets support iterative comparison/filtering of actual scholarly KG contributions, with saved result/configuration URLs.

descriptions.interaction: Typed dynamic facets on comparison-table columns; include/exclude values, numeric/date ranges, autocomplete and saved comparison subsets.
descriptions.guidance: Facets inferred from property templates and data type, changing with comparison content.
descriptions.visualisation: Comparison table, filter dialog, visible active filters and linked contribution objects.
descriptions.backend: Open Research Knowledge Graph comparisons and property templates; no SPARQL/Cypher operational backend specified in this report.
